data.name: Architecture-Interior-Design-Landing-Page-
data.description: A professionally crafted responsive layout for an interior and architecture firm, showcasing services, projects, and brand identity. Built with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript. Achieved a perfect 100/100 mobile responsiveness score via Google DevTools, ensuring flawless performance on all devices.

data.name: bootstrap-library
data.description: Built a high-performance admin panel with custom Bootstrap 5 components, dark/light mode toggle, and optimized SCSS/Gulp workflow.  Improved Lighthouse mobile usability score from 65 → 92 by reducing CSS payload (62%) and lazy-loading dashboards. Tech: Bootstrap 5 (SCSS), Chart.js, Gulp (PurgeCSS, minification), Vanilla JS (ES6+).

data.name: Financial-Consulting-Landing-Page
data.description: Designed a professional multi-section landing page for a financial consulting service using HTML5, CSS3, and Vanilla JavaScript. Created a fully responsive layout with service highlights, client testimonials, and a custom contact form with validation. Focused on clean design, easy navigation, and fast loading for optimal user experience.

data.name: hany-sass-utils
data.description: A lightweight and modular SCSS utility library that provides responsive spacing, flexbox, grid system, typography, buttons, and color classes. Built for fast front-end development with clean code and full SCSS customization. Gulp is used for SCSS compilation and optional CSS optimization.
